title: Mira Iyer：美国就业数据转弱，经济进入“加时赛”
speaker: Mira Iyer

segments.en: The employment number we got last week wasn't exactly rosy, 57,000 new jobs, a bit of a restatement down of some of the past numbers, but more importantly, participation rates down.
segments.zh: 上周的就业数据并不乐观，新增就业5.7万，前值也下修，更重要的是劳动参与率下降。

segments.en: Long-term unemployed up. The sense we have is that the U.S. economy is slowly entering, you know, either stoppage time to use a World Cup or extra time.
segments.zh: 长期失业人数上升。我们的感觉是，美国经济正缓慢进入——用世界杯术语来说——伤停补时或加时赛。

segments.en: Yes, exactly. And that means a slow down across the board. The gap between U.S. growth and non-U.S. growth ending potentially.
segments.zh: 没错，这意味着全面放缓。美国与非美国经济增长的差距可能正在收窄。
